questions.q: What is being discussed in parliament in this video?
o: That the Kaluđerski couple have lived on a farmstead without electricity for 20 years
The construction of a new bridge
questions.e: In the video: "bračni par Dragica i Danilo Kaluđerski u 21. veku žive bez struje... 20 godina vode uzaludnu borbu" — the married couple Dragica and Danilo Kaluđerski live without electricity in the 21st century... for 20 years they have been waging a futile struggle.

questions.q: Where is their salaš (farmstead) located?
o: Between Crvenka and Sivac, next to the Novi Sad – Sombor road
questions.e: In the video: "Na salašu između Crvenke i Sivca... odmah do regionalnog puta Novi Sad – Sombor" — on a salaš between Crvenka and Sivac... right next to the regional road Novi Sad – Sombor.

questions.q: How many people would get electricity if a line of about 4 km were built?
o: About a hundred farmsteads and weekend houses
questions.e: In the video: "priključilo oko stotinu salaša i vikendica" — about a hundred farmsteads and weekend houses would be connected.

questions.q: What did the minister promise?
o: To come, gather the people and discuss it with the head of the Kula municipality
To bring the power in right away
questions.e: In the video: "otići ću ja do njih, da oni skupe sve te ljude... sednu sa predsednikom opštine iz Kule" — I'll go to them, so that they gather all those people... sit down with the president of the municipality from Kula.

questions.q: What did the head of Elektrodistribucija say about the connection?
o: That the power will soon be there
That farmers and weekend-house owners are unprofitable for them
questions.e: In the video: "On je izjavio da smo mi... za njih neisplativi" — he stated that we are... unprofitable for them.

questions.q: How does the heroine charge her phone?
o: She takes a battery to be charged in the village and charges the phone from a car charger
questions.e: In the video: "imamo akumulator, koji odnesemo da se napuni u selo... na autopunjač napunim telefon" — we have a battery that we take to the village to be charged... I charge my phone from the car charger.

questions.q: Where does the heroine keep food?
o: In two freezers at friends' in Sivac, five kilometers away
In the fridge at the farmstead
questions.e: In the video: "imam u Sivcu dva zamrzivača, pet kilometara od kuće" — I have two freezers in Sivac, five kilometers from the house.

questions.q: How is the salaš registered?
o: As an ethno-salaš and tourist spot, for 12 years
questions.e: In the video: "registrovan kao etno-salaš, registrovan je kao turistička destinacija... 12 godina već" — registered as an ethno-salaš, registered as a tourist destination... for 12 years already.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Već 20 godina vode *uzaludnu* borbu.
questions.e: Uzaludan — futile, in vain.

questions.q: Salaš nije *zabačen*.
questions.e: Zabačen — secluded, far from roads.

questions.q: Da se *priključe* na taj električni vod.
questions.e: Priključiti se — to connect, to hook up.

questions.q: Ali ta *obećanja* su sva padala u vodu.
questions.e: Obećanje — a promise.

questions.q: Mi smo *neisplativi*.
questions.e: Isplativ — profitable, paying off; neisplativ — unprofitable.

questions.q: Ti *punjači* dobijaju neodređenu struju i tu pregorevaju.
questions.e: Punjač — a charger; puniti — to charge, to fill.

questions.q: To su sve *izdaci* i veoma veliki troškovi.
questions.e: Izdatak — an expense.

questions.q: Pa zar to nije *bruka*?
questions.e: Bruka — a disgrace, a shame.

questions.q: Salaš se nalazi odmah do regionalnog ___.
questions.e: Do ("next to") requires the genitive case: do puta.

questions.q: Dragica i Danilo žive bez ___.
questions.e: Bez ("without") requires the genitive case: bez struje.

questions.q: Da li je Srbija zaboravila na te male ___?
questions.e: Zaboraviti na + accusative case: na te male ljude.

questions.q: Kontaktiraju sa lokalnom ___ u Kuli.
questions.e: Sa ("with") requires the instrumental case: sa samoupravom.

questions.q: Salaš pripada ___.
questions.e: Pripadati to someone/something — dative case: Sivcu.

questions.q: Selo je udaljeno 2 ___ od salaša.
questions.e: After the numbers 2–4 the genitive singular is used: 2 kilometra.

questions.q: Ja sam sama išla prvo, zbog ___.
questions.e: Zbog ("because of, for the sake of") requires the genitive case: zbog sebe.

questions.q: Imam zamrzivač u selu, pet ___ od kuće.
questions.e: After the number 5 the genitive plural is used: pet kilometara.
